invariants.rationale: instantTime is expected to represent a point in time; should not be null at method entry.
preppedRecordInputs is a collection of records to update; should not be null at method entry.
fileGroupsIdsToUpdate represents file groups targeted for update; typically gated against null at method entry.
A valid writeClient is needed for upsert and commit operations.
Catch-all invariant: a non-empty list has size > 0, and an empty list has size = 0.
